notes: The waw takes *yea* and `גַּם` takes *even*: two written English words for two present morphemes, so rule 2 splits rather than fusing under rule 30, whose one-rendering condition fails because subtracting *even* leaves `גַּם` with nothing. This is not rule 14's correlative pair, which requires one connective morpheme rendered by a paired frame.
`יִהְיֶה` takes *shall be* with its auxiliary while the subject noun `רָעָה` keeps its own *evil* (rules 17, 20); `מַה` takes the determiner *what* written for it.
The ASV margin ('Divide a portion into seven') does not affect the morpheme-by-morpheme division; all 17 source and 20 target IDs are covered exactly once.
